en: Click on the Equipment Wargear drop (any mouse button) and it will be available for use when you return to the Strike Cruiser.
zh_new: 點擊掉落的裝備戰爭裝備（任意滑鼠鍵），返回打擊巡洋艦後即可使用。

en: Finding Rippa-Splitta is our only chance of locating the astronomic array in time.
zh_new: 找到殘虐裂手，是我們及時定位天文陣列的唯一機會。

en: Commander, we have located one of Rippa-Splitta’s lieutenants.
zh_new: 指揮官，我們已定位到殘虐裂手的一名副官。

en: We finally have Rippa Splitta’s location.
zh_new: 我們終於掌握了殘虐裂手的位置。

en: Deff Driva is our only link to Rippa-Splitta and the astronomic array.
zh_new: 死駕是我們通往殘虐裂手和天文陣列的唯一線索。

en: Find him and extract Rippa-Splitta’s location from him.
zh_new: 找到他，從他口中逼問出殘虐裂手的位置。

en: It seems the array has attracted the attention of an Ork named Rippa-Splitta.
zh_new: 看來這座陣列引起了一名叫殘虐裂手的獸人注意。

en: Deff Driva is our only link to Rippa-Splitta and the astronomic array. Do not let him escape.
zh_new: 死駕是我們通往殘虐裂手和天文陣列的唯一線索。別讓他逃走。

en: The Greenskin walker Rippa-Splitta is obsessed with technology. Destroy this alien walker, and recover the location of the astronomic array.
zh_new: 綠皮步行機殘虐裂手沉迷於科技。摧毀這台異族步行機，並回收天文陣列的位置。
